executive_summary: Maven compilation failed with 87 errors across multiple files. The primary root cause is missing Lombok-generated methods (getters/setters/builders) in entity and DTO classes. The @Data, @Builder, and @AllArgsConstructor annotations are not being processed, causing 'cannot find symbol' errors throughout the codebase. Additionally, there is a duplicate constructor definition in ColumnNotFoundException.

errors.root_cause: Duplicate constructor definition. The class likely has both an explicit constructor and a Lombok @AllArgsConstructor annotation generating the same constructor.
errors.fix_recommendation: Remove either the explicit constructor at line 9 or remove the @AllArgsConstructor annotation from the class to eliminate the duplicate.

errors.root_cause: Lombok @Builder annotation is not generating the builder() method. This affects ErrorResponse class used in GlobalExceptionHandler at multiple locations (lines 26, 38, 50, 62, 79, 92).
errors.fix_recommendation: Ensure Lombok is properly configured in pom.xml with annotation processing enabled. Add lombok-maven-plugin or configure maven-compiler-plugin with annotationProcessorPaths including Lombok. Verify @Builder annotation is present on ErrorResponse class.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: methods getId(), setId(), getTitle(), getStatus(), getUserId(), getCreatedAt(), getUpdatedAt(), setUpdatedAt(), etc.
errors.root_cause: Lombok @Data or @Getter/@Setter annotations are not generating accessor methods for Task entity. This causes cascading failures in InMemoryTaskDataStore, TaskDataStoreImpl, and TaskServiceImpl (45+ occurrences).
errors.fix_recommendation: Verify @Data annotation is present on Task entity class. Ensure Lombok annotation processing is enabled in maven-compiler-plugin configuration. Add <annotationProcessorPaths> with org.projectlombok:lombok dependency in the compiler plugin.

errors.message: does not override abstract method countByColumnId(String) in TaskDataStore
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore does not implement the countByColumnId method required by the TaskDataStore interface.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add the missing countByColumnId(String columnId) method implementation to InMemoryTaskDataStore class. The method should count and return the number of tasks associated with the given columnId.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: method builder() in multiple DTO classes
errors.root_cause: Multiple DTO classes (ColumnTaskCountResponse, TaskStatusUpdateResponse, TaskDetailsResponse, TaskSummary, ValidateTaskMoveResponse, PagedTaskResponse, TaskCountResponse, BulkTaskResponse, TaskResponse) are missing builder() methods due to Lombok not processing @Builder annotations.
errors.fix_recommendation: Configure Lombok annotation processing globally in pom.xml. Add maven-compiler-plugin configuration with annotationProcessorPaths including lombok dependency. Ensure all DTO classes have @Builder annotation.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: getter methods in request DTOs
errors.root_cause: Request DTO classes (TaskStatusUpdateRequest, TaskCreateRequest, TaskUpdateRequest, ValidateTaskMoveRequest) are missing getter methods (getStatus, getColumnId, getUserId, getTitle, getDescription, getPriority, getDueDate, getFromStatus, getToStatus) due to Lombok @Data or @Getter not being processed.
errors.fix_recommendation: Ensure all request DTO classes have @Data or @Getter annotations. Verify Lombok annotation processing is enabled in the Maven build configuration.

errors.message: incompatible types: inference variable T has incompatible bounds
errors.root_cause: Type inference failure when building TaskSummary objects, likely due to missing builder() method and incorrect generic type handling in the stream operation.
errors.fix_recommendation: Fix the Lombok configuration to generate builder() method for TaskSummary. Review the stream operation at line 78 to ensure proper type casting or explicit type parameters are provided.
